decision_record.question: How many active approval processes will this object have, and in what order?
decision_record.answer: One process for both record types, entered on discount above 20%.
decision_record.source: clarification-default (Q58 open at G1, default recorded as assumption A19)
decision_record.element: one <approvalProcess> file; order is not in the metadata - deploy-order.md section 4 carries it as A34

decision_record.question: Who may submit, and does that include portal or partner users?
decision_record.answer: The rep only; sales ops submits on a rep's behalf only through the exceptional bypass path.

decision_record.question: Who edits the record while it is pending - nobody, or the current approver too?
decision_record.answer: Only an admin; the manager approves or rejects, they do not edit.

decision_record.question: Where does each step's approver come from, and what happens when that source is empty?
decision_record.answer: The rep's direct manager through the user hierarchy (User.Manager). No fallback queue or pre-submission validation rule was specified.
decision_record.element: approver <type>userHierarchyField</type> with no <name>, plus <nextAutomatedApprover> carrying <userHierarchyField>Manager</userHierarchyField> and <useApproverFieldOfRecordOwner>true</useApproverFieldOfRecordOwner>. The empty-value path is unresolved and is recorded as an ambiguity, not as an answer.

decision_record.question: When an approver rejects at step 2, does the whole request die or go back to step 1?
decision_record.answer: A rejection ends the request; with one step there is no prior step to return to.
decision_record.source: clarification-default (Q60 open at G1, default recorded as assumption A21)
decision_record.element: no <rejectBehavior> element - it is not allowed on a first step in any case

decision_record.question: Do steps that do not match their criteria approve, reject, or skip?
decision_record.answer: Process entry criteria keep sub-cap discounts out of the process entirely, so no ifCriteriaNotMet path is exercised.
decision_record.source: clarification-default (Q61 open at G1, default recorded as assumption A22)
decision_record.element: no step-level <entryCriteria>, therefore no <ifCriteriaNotMet> - the worked example omits it on step 1 for the same reason

decision_record.question: Which actions fire on submit, approve, reject, and recall - and do those objects exist in the target org?
decision_record.answer: Submit: email to the manager, Approval_Status__c = Pending, record locked. Approve: email to the rep, = Approved, unlocked. Reject: email to the rep, = Rejected, unlocked. Recall: status cleared, unlocked, no email.
decision_record.element: <initialSubmissionActions> 1 FieldUpdate; <finalApprovalActions> FieldUpdate + Alert; <finalRejectionActions> FieldUpdate + Alert; <recallActions> 1 FieldUpdate (operation Null); the submit email is the process's own <emailTemplate>, not an alert

decision_record.question: Will this approval process ever have more than one approver on a single step?
decision_record.source: clarification-default (Q59 open at G1, default recorded as assumption A20)

decision_record.question: Who does the email come from, and who answers replies?
decision_record.answer: Current user. No verified org-wide address exists on any answer for this build.
decision_record.source: upstream artefact + decisions.md D-M3S01-01 (recorded at M3-S01's documentation pass)
decision_record.element: <senderType>CurrentUser</senderType> on both alerts, no <senderAddress> (illegal alongside CurrentUser)

decision_record.question: Is this template used by a rule or by Flow?
decision_record.answer: By two WorkflowAlerts and by the approval process's own emailTemplate element - all three Classic.

decision_record.question: Which record is the merge context?
decision_record.answer: Opportunity, for all three templates; settled at M3-S01.

decision_record.question: Could the same event fire twice?
decision_record.answer: No: submit sends one email, from the process's emailTemplate. No initialSubmissionActions alert was created.
decision_record.source: step inputs.note + upstream artefact (M3-S01 deploy-order.md section 1)

decision_record.question: Is any workflow field update or automation writing this field after save?
decision_record.answer: Yes - all four of this step's field updates write Approval_Status__c, and assumption A8 records that nothing else does.
